title: Japanese Walnut Pudding
description: A Japanese-inspired dessert featuring a rich walnut pudding. This dish combines the nutty flavors of walnuts with the subtle sweetness of Japanese-style pudding.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together pudding mix, milk, sugar, and egg until well combined.
Stir in vanilla extract and light corn syrup.
Melt butter in a small pan over low heat.
Add walnuts to the melted butter and cook for 2-3 minutes, until fragrant.
Fold the cooked walnuts into the pudding mixture.
Pour the mixture into 6-8 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pudding is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
